name: Remix a tool
summary: A chore wheel another group made, shown in the feed as a live preview that rebuilds itself with your group's names when you remix it.
useWhen: a feed post sharing a tool another group made: a chore wheel, a rota
'we should do this for our place', 'steal this for our suite'
dontUseWhen: running a chore rota in your own chat (use chore-wheel or chore-draft)
a plain post with nothing to reuse

params.groups: first the group that made it, then up to 3 groups of yours: {name, short, badge (1-3 chars), members (names), note}
params.base: remixes so far from outside the chat
params.remixers: up to 3 names shown in the proof row
